author: A. Ernst
heading_as_printed: I obtained lately a manuscript copy of the vocabularies of some languages spoken on the Upper Orinoco and its affluents which had been collected by Mr F. Montolieu, a Frenchman, who for several years acted first as secretary to the governor of the Venezuelan territory Amazonas and was finally governor himself (1870 to 1876).
place: Upper Orinoco and its affluents, Venezuelan territory Amazonas
about: Spanish-keyed vocabularies of Yavitero (second half, from L), Puinabo and Piaroa collected by F. Montolieu, a former governor of the Venezuelan territory Amazonas, and published by A. Ernst from a manuscript copy.
